value.rationale: A canonical m-edge bridge process between two fixed cliques yields a complete natural parameterized homotopy and integral barcode. The third-bridge topology change from transient circle to a first two-sphere, and the 2t-4 new permanent 2-classes per subsequent bridge, are exact structural phenomena not implied by the known final-stage homotopy. The primitive inclusion maps make the result usable as a controlled benchmark of neighborhood-complex persistence, beyond a small finite census.
